description.value: Friend meetup at Bryant Park is an easy Midtown plan. The park sits behind the New York Public Library's Stephen A. Schwarzman building between Fifth and Sixth Avenues. Its posted hours for October are daily, 7am-10pm, so an afternoon or early evening meetup fits well.
